verdict.rationale: Jan's own API reference documents an OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/chat/completions endpoint on its local server that "Supports streaming," so applications can receive tokens as they are generated. The evidence is a single brief first-party statement, with no detail on the streaming protocol. Missing for 10: documentation of the streaming wire format (e.g. SSE chunks, the stream parameter), a streaming code example, streaming support on the /v1/messages endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream generated tokens back to my application as they are produced

citations.quote: Supports streaming, tool calling, and multi-turn conversations
